rule: 主.次.本.末 = user-controlled major / functional iteration / user validation round / project CI build sequence
migration: Preserve major0; existing0.2 is the migration baseline. This functional iteration is0.3.0; reset display-build at the observed previous project run_number250, so its next official build is0.3.0.1. No global toolbox counter.
retryPolicy: A GitHub re-run must not produce a duplicate build identity: use a fresh workflow_dispatch (new run_number), not re-run old jobs.
counterScope: GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER of this repository and this fixed workflow path. Changing workflow counter lineage or code offset requires an explicit version migration review. Display sequence = project run_number minus buildSequenceOrigin. When minor or user validation round advances, review and reset origin to the last allocated project run number; Android code never resets.
